ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. To improve its loading time, consider optimizing images, minifying CSS and JavaScript files, and reducing the number of HTTP requests.
insights: The pricing page and blog page have faster load times than the homepage, indicating that they may have been optimized for performance.
The Time to First Byte (TTFB) for all pages is relatively low, indicating that the server is responding quickly to requests.
The First Contentful Paint (FCP) for all pages is also low, suggesting that the pages are rendering quickly and providing a good user experience.
